stack: React 19 + plain CSS (no Tailwind/shadcn); tokens in apps/web/src/styles.css
constraints: First visit <= 300 KB, repeat visit <= 50 KB (Milestone 1, Requirement 5)
360 px wide with no sideways scrolling
WCAG 4.5:1 text contrast, visible focus, 44-48 px touch targets
Low-cost Android phones, bright outdoor light, weak networks, possibly low literacy

decisions.summary: One question per screen with a segmented progress bar, radio cards, Back/Next in a bar fixed to the bottom, and a final Check and send screen.
rejected: B. One calm page (single form with folded optional sections)
C. Evidence first (photo and location buttons first): nudges reporters to stay near the site, against the proposal's safety stance
Illustrated, animated SVG landscape scenes (removed at the user's request, commit ada9534)

decisions.summary: Website and officer app moved from #1f6b45 / grey page to the logo green #1f4d3a on cream #f5f1e6, with gold accents.

rules: Gold is decorative only (1.9:1 on cream): focus halo and the bar under headings, never text or meaning
White on green 9.6:1; green text on cream 8.5:1
